name: Forward Scattering Dipole Model
aliases: Functional Integral Approximation for Radiative Transport
definition: An analytical subsurface scattering model derived from the functional integral formulation of radiative transport, linked to the partition function of a worm-like chain in polymer physics. It explicitly assumes strong forward scattering to avoid errors from isotropic diffusion assumptions in optically dense media.
summary: The Forward Scattering Dipole Model is an analytical subsurface scattering method that explicitly encodes phase function anisotropy to accurately model light transport in optically dense, highly anisotropic media where standard diffusion approximations fail.
